title: Battery — DPP characteristics
description: Field specifications for the Battery Digital Product Passport, shaped for UNTP's credentialSubject.characteristics extension point. Economic operators and facility identifiers are carried by the UNTP envelope and are deliberately absent here.

batteryIdDmcCode.title: Battery ID DMC Code
batteryIdDmcCode.description: Data Matrix Code printed on the physical battery for scanning
batteryIdDmcCode.x-citationNote: Art. 13(6) requires every battery to be marked with a QR code (Annex VI Part C); no provision requires a Data Matrix code, and the marking is on the battery, not passport data.

batteryPassportIdentifier.title: Battery Passport Identifier
batteryPassportIdentifier.description: UUID identifying the digital battery passport document
batteryPassportIdentifier.x-citationNote: The Regulation names one identifier, the unique identifier of Art. 77(3) (batteryUniqueIdentifier). A separate passport identifier is not a legal datum.

manufacturerEmail.title: Manufacturer Email
manufacturerEmail.description: Contact email address of the manufacturer
manufacturerEmail.x-citationNote: It requires the manufacturer to indicate a postal address, and where available an electronic address, ON the battery or its packaging or in an accompanying document. It is an economic-operator contact duty discharged by marking, not an Annex XIII passport item; publishing it here exceeds the duty and is good practice rather than compliance.

manufacturingDate.title: Manufacturing Date
manufacturingDate.description: Date of manufacture in YYYY-MM format
manufacturingDate.x-provision: Annex XIII 1(a) with Annex VI Part A(4)

manufacturingPlace.title: Manufacturing Place
manufacturingPlace.description: Manufacturing facility details including name, address, country, and GPS coordinates
manufacturingPlace.x-provision: Annex XIII 1(a) with Annex VI Part A(3)

batteryCategory.title: Battery Category
batteryCategory.description: Classification of the battery per EU Regulation 2023/1542
batteryCategory.x-provision: Annex XIII 1(a) with Annex VI Part A(2)

batteryWeight.title: Battery Weight
batteryWeight.description: Total weight of the battery in kilograms
batteryWeight.x-provision: Annex XIII 1(a) with Annex VI Part A(5)

batteryStatus.title: Battery Status
batteryStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the battery

separateCollectionSymbol.title: Separate Collection Symbol
separateCollectionSymbol.description: The separate-collection marking (the crossed-out wheeled bin symbol) the battery bears under Art. 13(4), which Annex XIII 1(q) puts in the passport.

cadmiumSymbol.title: Cadmium Symbol
cadmiumSymbol.description: Indicates whether battery contains cadmium above 0.002% threshold, requiring Cd symbol
cadmiumSymbol.x-citationNote: It is a duty to PRINT the chemical symbol on the battery — 'Cd' above 0.002% cadmium — beneath the separate-collection symbol and at least a quarter of its size. The obligation is discharged by the mark, not by a passport field; Annex XIII 1(q) cross-references these marking requirements, which the corrigendum of 10 April 2026 corrected to Art. 13(4) and (5).

leadSymbol.title: Lead Symbol
leadSymbol.description: Indicates whether battery contains lead above 0.004% threshold, requiring Pb symbol
leadSymbol.x-citationNote: It requires the 'Pb' symbol to be printed on batteries containing more than 0.004% lead, beneath the separate-collection symbol. A physical marking duty, not passport data; Annex XIII 1(q) merely cross-references it. The corrigendum of 10 April 2026 (OJ L 2026/90285) corrected the cross-reference from 'Article 13(3) and (4)' to 'Article 13(4) and (5)'.

carbonFootprintLabel.title: Carbon Footprint Label
carbonFootprintLabel.description: Image or URL of the carbon footprint label affixed to the battery
carbonFootprintLabel.x-citationNote: Art. 7(1) requires a carbon footprint declaration and Annex XIII 1(c) carries that information into the passport, but the declaration's format and the calculation methodology come from a delegated act that is not adopted. The label form in particular does not yet exist to be produced.

meaningOfLabelsAndSymbols.title: Meaning of Labels and Symbols
meaningOfLabelsAndSymbols.description: Explanation of all labels and symbols on the battery or link to documentation

euDeclarationOfConformity.title: EU Declaration of Conformity
euDeclarationOfConformity.description: EU Declaration of Conformity with identification number and URL to the document

testReportResults.title: Results of Test Reports
testReportResults.description: Results of test reports performed on the battery, accessible to authorities

ceMarking.title: CE Marking
ceMarking.description: Whether the battery bears the CE marking
ceMarking.x-citationNote: Art. 20(1) requires the CE marking ON the battery. It is not an Annex XIII passport point.

carbonFootprintTotal.title: Battery Carbon Footprint — Total
carbonFootprintTotal.description: Total carbon footprint of the battery over its lifecycle in kg CO2 equivalent per kWh
carbonFootprintTotal.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(c) makes the Art. 7(1) and (2) carbon footprint information passport content, so this is a genuine future passport field — but the Art. 7(1) declaration depends on a calculation methodology delegated act that has not been adopted, so nothing today fixes how the figure is computed.

cfRawMaterialAcquisition.title: CF — Raw Material Acquisition & Pre-processing
cfRawMaterialAcquisition.description: Carbon footprint share from raw material acquisition and pre-processing phase
cfRawMaterialAcquisition.x-citationNote: A lifecycle stage of the Art. 7(1) declaration, carried into the passport by Annex XIII 1(c). The per-stage breakdown follows the calculation methodology that the unadopted delegated act will set.

cfMainProductProduction.title: CF — Main Product Production
cfMainProductProduction.description: Carbon footprint share from the main battery production/assembly phase
cfMainProductProduction.x-citationNote: A lifecycle stage of the Art. 7(1) declaration, carried into the passport by Annex XIII 1(c), pending the calculation methodology delegated act.

cfDistribution.title: CF — Distribution
cfDistribution.description: Carbon footprint share from the distribution/transport phase
cfDistribution.x-citationNote: A lifecycle stage of the Art. 7(1) declaration, carried into the passport by Annex XIII 1(c), pending the calculation methodology delegated act.

cfEndOfLifeRecycling.title: CF — End of Life & Recycling
cfEndOfLifeRecycling.description: Carbon footprint share from end-of-life treatment and recycling phase
cfEndOfLifeRecycling.x-citationNote: A lifecycle stage of the Art. 7(1) declaration, carried into the passport by Annex XIII 1(c), pending the calculation methodology delegated act.

carbonFootprintPerformanceClass.title: Carbon Footprint Performance Class
carbonFootprintPerformanceClass.description: Performance class rating from A (best) to G (worst) for carbon footprint
carbonFootprintPerformanceClass.x-citationNote: Performance classes are carried into the passport by Annex XIII 1(c), but the classes themselves are established by a delegated act that has not been adopted. There is no class to declare until it is.

carbonFootprintStudyUrl.title: Carbon Footprint Study URL
carbonFootprintStudyUrl.description: Web link to the publicly accessible carbon footprint study
carbonFootprintStudyUrl.x-citationNote: The supporting study is the evidence behind the Art. 7(1) declaration rather than a declared Annex XIII item. Publishing a link is voluntary transparency.

supplyChainDueDiligenceReport.title: Supply Chain Due Diligence Report
supplyChainDueDiligenceReport.description: URL to the supply chain due diligence report
supplyChainDueDiligenceReport.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(d) makes the Art. 52(3) due diligence report passport content, so this is genuine passport data — but Art. 52 applies from 18 Aug 2027 and the report is due in the passport from Aug 2028, later than the passport itself.

dueDiligencePolicy.title: Due Diligence Policy
dueDiligencePolicy.description: URL to the company's due diligence policy document
dueDiligencePolicy.x-citationNote: It requires the policy to exist and be verified; what Annex XIII 1(d) carries into the passport is the Art. 52(3) REPORT on that policy, not the policy document. Publishing the policy itself is voluntary.

thirdPartyAuditResults.title: Third-Party Audit Results
thirdPartyAuditResults.description: URL to third-party audit results, accessible to authorities only
thirdPartyAuditResults.x-citationNote: Third-party verification is part of the Art. 52 due diligence regime, and its results support the Art. 52(3) report that Annex XIII 1(d) carries. The audit output itself is not separately enumerated as passport content.

batteryChemistry.title: Battery Chemistry
batteryChemistry.description: Battery chemistry type (e.g. NMC811, LFP, NCA, LTO, NMC622)
batteryChemistry.x-provision: Annex XIII 1(a) with Annex VI Part A(7)

cathodeActiveMaterials.title: Cathode Active Materials
cathodeActiveMaterials.description: List of cathode active materials with name and weight percentage

anodeActiveMaterials.title: Anode Active Materials
anodeActiveMaterials.description: List of anode active materials with name and weight percentage

electrolyteComposition.title: Electrolyte Composition
electrolyteComposition.description: List of electrolyte components with name and weight percentage

criticalRawMaterials.title: Critical Raw Materials
criticalRawMaterials.description: Critical raw materials present in the battery in a concentration above 0.1 % weight by weight (Annex VI Part A(10), via Annex XIII 1(a)). List each with its name and share.
criticalRawMaterials.x-provision: Annex XIII 1(a) with Annex VI Part A(10)

hazardousSubstances.title: Hazardous Substances
hazardousSubstances.description: Hazardous substances present in the battery other than mercury, cadmium or lead: substances classified as hazardous under Art. 3 of Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008 (Annex VI Part A(8), via Annex XIII 1(a)). List each with its name, its CAS number where it has one, and where it is in the battery.
hazardousSubstances.x-provision: Annex XIII 1(a) with Annex VI Part A(8)

scipNotificationNumber.title: SCIP Notification Number
scipNotificationNumber.description: SCIP database notification number for articles containing SVHCs
scipNotificationNumber.x-citationNote: No provision of Reg (EU) 2023/1542 requires a SCIP notification number in the passport; the SCIP duty is a notification to ECHA under the Waste Framework Directive.

recycledContentCobalt.title: Recycled Content — Cobalt
recycledContentCobalt.description: Percentage of recycled cobalt in the battery
recycledContentCobalt.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) carries the Art. 8(1) recycled-content information into the passport. Art. 8(1) applies from 18 August 2028 or 24 months after the calculation-methodology delegated act enters into force, whichever is later (LMT batteries from 18 August 2033); minimum shares apply from 18 August 2031 (Art. 8(2)) and 18 August 2036 (Art. 8(3)). The methodology act is not yet adopted, so the field is anticipated.

recycledContentLithium.title: Recycled Content — Lithium
recycledContentLithium.description: Percentage of recycled lithium in the battery
recycledContentLithium.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) carries the Art. 8(1) recycled-content information into the passport. Art. 8(1) applies from 18 August 2028 or 24 months after the calculation-methodology delegated act enters into force, whichever is later (LMT batteries from 18 August 2033); minimum shares apply from 18 August 2031 (Art. 8(2)) and 18 August 2036 (Art. 8(3)). The methodology act is not yet adopted, so the field is anticipated.

recycledContentNickel.title: Recycled Content — Nickel
recycledContentNickel.description: Percentage of recycled nickel in the battery
recycledContentNickel.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) carries the Art. 8(1) recycled-content information into the passport. Art. 8(1) applies from 18 August 2028 or 24 months after the calculation-methodology delegated act enters into force, whichever is later (LMT batteries from 18 August 2033); minimum shares apply from 18 August 2031 (Art. 8(2)) and 18 August 2036 (Art. 8(3)). The methodology act is not yet adopted, so the field is anticipated.

recycledContentLead.title: Recycled Content — Lead
recycledContentLead.description: Percentage of recycled lead in the battery
recycledContentLead.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) carries the Art. 8(1) recycled-content information into the passport. Art. 8(1) applies from 18 August 2028 or 24 months after the calculation-methodology delegated act enters into force, whichever is later (LMT batteries from 18 August 2033); minimum shares apply from 18 August 2031 (Art. 8(2)) and 18 August 2036 (Art. 8(3)). The methodology act is not yet adopted, so the field is anticipated.

roleOfEndUsersInWastePrevention.title: Role of End-Users in Waste Prevention
roleOfEndUsersInWastePrevention.description: Information on the role of end-users in contributing to waste prevention, including by responsible use and proper disposal

informationOnSeparateCollection.title: Information on Separate Collection
informationOnSeparateCollection.description: Information about separate collection requirements and available collection points

informationOnCollectionAndEndOfLifeTreat.title: Collection and End-of-Life Treatment Information
informationOnCollectionAndEndOfLifeTreat.description: Link to information on separate collection, take-back and collection points, preparation for re-use, preparation for repurposing, and treatment available for waste batteries (Annex XIII 1(s) carrying Art. 74(1)(c)).

dismantlingInformation.title: Dismantling Information / Manual
dismantlingInformation.description: URL to dismantling manual or instructions for safe battery dismantling

removalInformation.title: Removal Information / Manual
removalInformation.description: URL to battery removal manual or instructions for safe battery removal from the product
removalInformation.x-citationNote: Art. 11(1) removal and replacement instructions cover products incorporating PORTABLE batteries, which carry no passport; not an Annex XIII point.

sparePartsInformation.title: Spare Parts Information
sparePartsInformation.description: Spare parts catalogue plus the contact details of sources for replacement spares — postal address and e-mail, not only a web link

safetyInformationEndOfLife.title: Safety Information for End-of-Life
safetyInformationEndOfLife.description: Safety measures and precautions for end-of-life handling of the battery

recycledContentDocumentation.title: Recycled Content Documentation
recycledContentDocumentation.description: Supporting documentation for recycled content claims, accessible to authorities
recycledContentDocumentation.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) carries the Art. 8(1) recycled-content figures into the passport by reference to the documentation that evidences them, which is what this link points at.

batteryRemovabilityReplaceability.title: Battery Removability & Replaceability
batteryRemovabilityReplaceability.description: Whether the battery can be removed and replaced by the end-user or professional
batteryRemovabilityReplaceability.x-citationNote: Art. 11(5) is a design duty for LMT products, not an Annex XIII passport datum.

ratedCapacity.title: Rated Capacity
ratedCapacity.description: Rated capacity of the battery in ampere-hours

nominalVoltage.title: Nominal Voltage
nominalVoltage.description: Nominal voltage of the battery in volts

minimumVoltage.title: Minimum Voltage
minimumVoltage.description: Minimum allowed voltage of the battery in volts

maximumVoltage.title: Maximum Voltage
maximumVoltage.description: Maximum allowed voltage of the battery in volts

originalPowerCapability.title: Original Power Capability
originalPowerCapability.description: Original power capability of the battery in watts

maximumAllowedBatteryPower.title: Maximum Allowed Battery Power
maximumAllowedBatteryPower.description: Maximum allowed battery power output in watts

ratioMaxPowerMaxEnergy.title: Ratio Nominal Power / Energy
ratioMaxPowerMaxEnergy.description: Ratio between nominal battery power (W) and battery energy (Wh), an element of the technical documentation (Annex IV Part B(2)). Voluntary; not an Annex XIII passport item.
ratioMaxPowerMaxEnergy.x-citationNote: Annex IV Part B(2) requires this ratio in the technical documentation that explains the Art. 10(1) measurements. It is not Annex XIII passport content and binds nothing in the passport.

initialEnergyRoundTripEfficiency.title: Initial Energy Round-Trip Efficiency
initialEnergyRoundTripEfficiency.description: Initial round-trip energy efficiency as a percentage
initialEnergyRoundTripEfficiency.x-citationNote: Initial round trip energy efficiency, and the same at 50% of cycle-life, is publicly accessible passport content from 18 Feb 2027. It binds for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the field is not flagged required at template level only because the duty is not uniform across battery types — see validation.requiredBy.

initialInternalResistancePack.title: Initial Internal Resistance — Pack
initialInternalResistancePack.description: Initial internal resistance of the battery pack in ohms

initialInternalResistanceCell.title: Initial Internal Resistance — Cell
initialInternalResistanceCell.description: Initial internal resistance per cell in ohms

initialInternalResistanceModule.title: Initial Internal Resistance — Module
initialInternalResistanceModule.description: Initial internal resistance per module in ohms
initialInternalResistanceModule.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(o) names 'internal battery cell and pack resistance'; module resistance is not a legal datum.

initialSelfDischargeRate.title: Initial Self-Discharge Rate
initialSelfDischargeRate.description: Initial self-discharge rate expressed as percentage per month
initialSelfDischargeRate.x-provision: Annex XIII 4(b) with Annex VII Part A(4)
initialSelfDischargeRate.x-citationNote: Self-discharge is Annex VII state-of-health data (via Annex XIII 4(b)) for stationary storage and LMT batteries, not an Annex XIII point-1 datum.

batteryEnergyTotal.title: Battery Energy Total
batteryEnergyTotal.description: Nominal (rated) energy of the battery in kWh: rated capacity (Ah) × nominal voltage (V) ÷ 1000. Not the usable energy, which is lower.

energyDensity.title: Energy Density
energyDensity.description: Gravimetric energy density in watt-hours per kilogram

expectedLifetimeCycles.title: Expected Lifetime — Cycles
expectedLifetimeCycles.description: Expected number of charge-discharge cycles over the battery lifetime
expectedLifetimeCycles.x-citationNote: Expected battery lifetime in cycles, together with the reference test used, is publicly accessible passport content from 18 Feb 2027. It binds for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the field is not flagged required at template level only because the duty is not uniform across battery types — see validation.requiredBy.

expectedLifetimeYears.title: Expected Lifetime — Years
expectedLifetimeYears.description: Expected calendar lifetime of the battery in years
expectedLifetimeYears.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. It binds from 18 Feb 2027 for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the template-level flag is false because the duty varies by battery type — see validation.requiredBy.

expectedLifetimeReferenceConditions.title: Expected Lifetime — Reference Conditions
expectedLifetimeReferenceConditions.description: Description of the reference test conditions under which lifetime expectations were determined
expectedLifetimeReferenceConditions.x-citationNote: It requires the reference test alongside the expected lifetime, so the conditions are part of that publicly accessible passport item rather than an extra.

capacityThresholdForExhaustion.title: Capacity Threshold for Exhaustion
capacityThresholdForExhaustion.description: Remaining capacity percentage below which the battery is considered exhausted
capacityThresholdForExhaustion.x-citationNote: The capacity threshold for exhaustion is publicly accessible passport content, and the Annex scopes it explicitly to ELECTRIC VEHICLE batteries only. That is why it is not required category-wide; see validation.requiredBy.

temperatureRangeIdleMin.title: Temperature Range Idle — Min
temperatureRangeIdleMin.description: Minimum ambient temperature for idle/storage state in degrees Celsius

temperatureRangeIdleMax.title: Temperature Range Idle — Max
temperatureRangeIdleMax.description: Maximum ambient temperature for idle/storage state in degrees Celsius

cRateRelevantCycleLifeTest.title: C-Rate of Relevant Cycle-Life Test
cRateRelevantCycleLifeTest.description: C-rate used in the cycle-life test that determined the expected lifetime
cRateRelevantCycleLifeTest.x-citationNote: The c-rate of the relevant cycle-life test is publicly accessible passport content from 18 Feb 2027. It binds for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the field is not flagged required at template level only because the duty is not uniform across battery types — see validation.requiredBy.

commercialWarrantyPeriod.title: Commercial Warranty Period
commercialWarrantyPeriod.description: Duration of the commercial warranty in years
commercialWarrantyPeriod.x-citationNote: The period for which the commercial warranty for calendar life applies is publicly accessible passport content from 18 Feb 2027. It binds for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the field is not flagged required at template level only because the duty is not uniform across battery types — see validation.requiredBy.

numberOfCells.title: Number of Cells
numberOfCells.description: Total number of cells in the battery pack

cellType.title: Cell Type
cellType.description: Physical form factor of the battery cells

stateOfHealth.title: State of Health — SoH
stateOfHealth.description: Overall state of health (%) as reported by the battery management system: the battery's general condition compared with its initial condition (Art. 3(1)(28)). For EV batteries the legal state-of-health parameter is the state of certified energy (stateOfCertifiedEnergy); for LMT and stationary storage batteries it is the Annex VII Part A set.
stateOfHealth.x-citationNote: State of health pursuant to Art. 14 is per-battery data that the Regulation restricts to persons with a legitimate interest, never the public. Art. 14 separately requires the battery management system to hold the underlying data with read-only access.

stateOfCertifiedEnergy.title: State of Certified Energy — SOCE
stateOfCertifiedEnergy.description: Certified energy remaining as a percentage
stateOfCertifiedEnergy.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. It binds from 18 Feb 2027 for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the template-level flag is false because the duty varies by battery type — see validation.requiredBy.

remainingCapacity.title: Remaining Capacity
remainingCapacity.description: Current remaining capacity of the battery in ampere-hours
remainingCapacity.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. remainingPowerCapability.title: Remaining Power Capability
remainingPowerCapability.description: Current remaining power capability of the battery in watts

remainingEnergy.title: Remaining Energy
remainingEnergy.description: Current remaining usable energy of the battery in kWh
remainingEnergy.x-citationNote: Remaining energy is part of the Art. 14 state-of-health parameter set that Annex XIII 4(b) makes available to persons with a legitimate interest only. It is per-battery data, never public passport content. Not an Annex VII Part A item.

currentInternalResistancePack.title: Ohmic Resistance — Pack (State of Health)

Not the Annex IV internal resistance (total effective resistance), which is dynamicInternalResistance.
currentInternalResistancePack.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. It binds from 18 Feb 2027 for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the template-level flag is false because the duty varies by battery type — see validation.requiredBy.

internalResistanceIncrease.title: Internal Resistance Increase

internalResistanceIncrease.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. numberOfFullEquivalentChargingCycles.title: Number of Full Equivalent Charging Cycles
numberOfFullEquivalentChargingCycles.description: Total number of full equivalent charging cycles completed
numberOfFullEquivalentChargingCycles.x-citationNote: It covers data resulting from use, including the number of charging and discharging cycles. Per-battery data, accessible only to persons with a legitimate interest.

capacityThroughput.title: Capacity Throughput
capacityThroughput.description: Cumulative charge passed through the battery over its life, in ampere-hours

energyThroughput.title: Energy Throughput
energyThroughput.description: Cumulative energy passed through the battery over its life, in kilowatt-hours

numberOfChargingEvents.title: Number of Charging Events
numberOfChargingEvents.description: Total number of charging events (partial or full) recorded
numberOfChargingEvents.x-citationNote: Data resulting from use, including charging and discharging cycles. Per-battery data restricted to persons with a legitimate interest.

batteryModelIdentifier.title: Battery Model Identifier

ceMarkingStatus.title: CE Marking Status

extinguishingAgent.title: Extinguishing Agent

renewableContentShare.title: Share of Renewable Content

componentPartNumbers.title: Part Numbers for Components

dynamicEnergyRoundTripEfficiency.title: Energy Round-Trip Efficiency (Dynamic, %)

dynamicEnergyRoundTripEfficiency.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. It binds from 18 Feb 2027 for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the template-level flag is false because the duty varies by battery type — see validation.requiredBy.

dynamicRatedCapacity.title: Rated Capacity (Dynamic, in Ah)
dynamicRatedCapacity.description: Rated capacity in ampere-hours as stated in the Art. 10(1) performance document (Annex IV Part A) when the battery is placed on the market, updated at each change of its status such as repurposing (Annex XIII 4(a)). Distinct from remainingCapacity, the battery management system's state-of-health reading (Annex XIII 4(b)).
dynamicRatedCapacity.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. It binds from 18 Feb 2027 for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the template-level flag is false because the duty varies by battery type — see validation.requiredBy.

dynamicInternalResistance.title: Internal Resistance (Dynamic, in Ω)
dynamicInternalResistance.description: Internal resistance in ohms as stated in the Art. 10(1) performance document (Annex IV Part A) when the battery is placed on the market, updated at each change of its status (Annex XIII 4(a)). Distinct from currentInternalResistancePack, the ohmic resistance read from the battery management system (Annex XIII 4(b)).
dynamicInternalResistance.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. It binds from 18 Feb 2027 for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the template-level flag is false because the duty varies by battery type — see validation.requiredBy.

dynamicExpectedLifetimeCycles.title: Expected Lifetime (Dynamic, in cycles)
dynamicExpectedLifetimeCycles.description: Expected lifetime in cycles as stated in the Art. 10(1) performance document (Annex IV Part A) when the battery is placed on the market, updated at each change of its status (Annex XIII 4(a)). Excluded for non-cycle applications.
dynamicExpectedLifetimeCycles.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. It binds from 18 Feb 2027 for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the template-level flag is false because the duty varies by battery type — see validation.requiredBy.

remainingRoundTripEfficiency.title: Remaining Round-Trip Efficiency
remainingRoundTripEfficiency.description: Where possible, the remaining energy round-trip efficiency as part of the state-of-health information per Annex XIII 4(b) DP 64. Applies to LMT batteries (mandatory); conditional for industrial; not applicable to EV.
remainingRoundTripEfficiency.x-citationNote: Annex XIII point 4 is per-battery data that the Regulation makes accessible ONLY to persons with a legitimate interest, never to the public. It binds from 18 Feb 2027 for LMT, industrial >2 kWh and EV batteries; the template-level flag is false because the duty varies by battery type — see validation.requiredBy.

preConsumerRecycledNickelShare.title: Pre-Consumer Recycled Nickel Share
preConsumerRecycledNickelShare.description: Percentage of Nickel from pre-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentNickel figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).
preConsumerRecycledNickelShare.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) carries the recycled content information contained in the Art. 8(1) documentation into the passport. Art. 8 recognises PRE-consumer and post-consumer recyclate differently, and the share targets themselves phase in from 18 Aug 2031, so the passport item exists before the minima bite.

preConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.title: Pre-Consumer Recycled Cobalt Share
preConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.description: Percentage of Cobalt from pre-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentCobalt figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).
preConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) passport content, sourced from the Art. 8(1) recycled-content documentation. The Art. 8 minimum shares apply from 18 Aug 2031.

preConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.title: Pre-Consumer Recycled Lithium Share
preConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.description: Percentage of Lithium from pre-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentLithium figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).
preConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) passport content, sourced from the Art. 8(1) recycled-content documentation. The Art. 8 minimum shares apply from 18 Aug 2031.

postConsumerRecycledNickelShare.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Nickel Share
postConsumerRecycledNickelShare.description: Percentage of Nickel from post-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentNickel figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).
postConsumerRecycledNickelShare.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) passport content, sourced from the Art. 8(1) recycled-content documentation; post-consumer recyclate is the share the Art. 8 targets are written against, applying from 18 Aug 2031.

postConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Cobalt Share
postConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.description: Percentage of Cobalt from post-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentCobalt figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).
postConsumerRecycledCobaltShare.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) passport content, sourced from the Art. 8(1) recycled-content documentation; the Art. 8 minimum shares apply from 18 Aug 2031.

postConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Lithium Share
postConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.description: Percentage of Lithium from post-consumer recycled waste in the battery's active materials. Complements the combined recycledContentLithium figure by splitting it into waste-origin streams per Annex XIII 1(e).
postConsumerRecycledLithiumShare.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(e) passport content, sourced from the Art. 8(1) recycled-content documentation; the Art. 8 minimum shares apply from 18 Aug 2031.

originalPowerCapabilityAt80Soc.title: Original Power Capability at 80% SoC
originalPowerCapabilityAt80Soc.description: Power capability of the battery at 80% state of charge (Watts). Together with the 20% SoC figure forms the OriginalPowerCapability GEFEG composite required by Annex XIII 1(i).
originalPowerCapabilityAt80Soc.x-citationNote: Power capability at 80 % and 20 % state of charge is one of the Annex IV Part B elements explaining the measurements, which Art. 10(1) second subparagraph places in the technical documentation. The passport datum is originalPowerCapability (Annex XIII 1(i)); this supplementary value is optional.

originalPowerCapabilityAt20Soc.title: Original Power Capability at 20% SoC
originalPowerCapabilityAt20Soc.description: Power capability of the battery at 20% state of charge (Watts). Together with the 80% SoC figure forms the OriginalPowerCapability GEFEG composite required by Annex XIII 1(i).
originalPowerCapabilityAt20Soc.x-citationNote: Power capability at 80 % and 20 % state of charge is one of the Annex IV Part B elements explaining the measurements, which Art. 10(1) second subparagraph places in the technical documentation. The passport datum is originalPowerCapability (Annex XIII 1(i)); this supplementary value is optional.

temperatureInformation.title: Temperature Information
temperatureInformation.description: Single Celsius temperature figure characterising the battery's thermal operating or design condition (integer, can be negative). Distinct from temperatureConditionsHistorical, which is a descriptive record of historical temperature ranges.
temperatureInformation.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 4(d) covers periodically recorded operating environmental conditions including temperature. Per-battery data restricted to persons with a legitimate interest; distinct from the Annex XIII 1(l) non-use temperature range, which is public.

cadmiumLeadSymbolsUrl.title: Cadmium and Lead Symbols URL
cadmiumLeadSymbolsUrl.description: URI linking to the artwork or documentation for the cadmium and lead chemical symbols required to be marked on the battery per Art. 13(5). Complements the cadmiumSymbol and leadSymbol boolean fields, which only indicate presence.
cadmiumLeadSymbolsUrl.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 1(s) carries the Art. 74(1)(a)-(f) waste-management information into the publicly accessible passport, and 1(q) cross-references the Art. 13(4) and (5) marking requirements. The Cd/Pb symbols themselves are discharged by printing them on the battery; a link documents that marking rather than replacing it.

componentPartNumbersUrl.title: Component Part Numbers URL
componentPartNumbersUrl.description: URI linking to a list of part numbers for components and spare parts of the battery per Annex XIII 2(b). Complements the componentPartNumbers array field, which holds the structured part-number list; this URI field satisfies the GEFEG format:uri requirement.
componentPartNumbersUrl.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 2(b) — part numbers for components and contact details of sources for replacement spares — is passport content accessible only to persons with a legitimate interest and the Commission, not to the public.

sparePartsSourcesUrl.title: Spare Parts Sources URL
sparePartsSourcesUrl.description: URI linking to information on sources where spare parts can be obtained for the battery per Annex XIII 2(b). When present, takes precedence over the URL derived from the sparePartsInformation.catalogUrl field in the GEFEG export.
sparePartsSourcesUrl.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 2(b) covers contact details of sources for replacement spares, accessible only to persons with a legitimate interest and the Commission.

accidentsInformationUrl.title: Accidents Information URL
accidentsInformationUrl.description: URI linking to information on accidents relating to the battery per Annex XIII 4(d). Complements the negativeEvents array field, which holds structured event records; this URI field satisfies the GEFEG format:uri requirement.
accidentsInformationUrl.x-citationNote: Annex XIII 4(d) names negative events such as accidents as per-battery data accessible only to persons with a legitimate interest. A link is a delivery convenience; the access restriction still governs what it resolves to.
